categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of automatic weighing equipment (衡器). Main products include microcomputer combination scales (微机组合秤), loss-in-weight feeders (失重秤), detection equipment, and related accessories. The company operates two main business divisions: measurement equipment and detection equipment. Products are widely used in food, pharmaceutical, plastic/chemical, and water utility industries for automatic weighing, metering, and continuous batching operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies involve software technology, precision mechanical manufacturing, and electrical control systems. The company employs an order-based assembly production model (订单装配式生产模式) where production is planned based on sales orders and forecasts. The company has established a comprehensive R&D system and holds 155 patents including 11 invention patents, 18 design patents, 87 utility model patents, 6 trademark registrations, and 33 computer software copyrights. Key R&D projects include various microcomputer combination scales, loss-in-weight feeders, metal detectors, and smart water meters.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers across multiple industries including food processing, pharmaceuticals, plastic/chemical manufacturing, and water utilities. The company has a diversified customer base with no significant customer concentration risk. In 2024, the top five customers accounted for 24.61% of total sales revenue. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with international sales representing 40.01% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Foshan, Guangdong Province, China. It operates through multiple subsidiaries including operations in Hunan Province (Xiangrikui Software), Taiwan (Taiwan Highdream Machinery), and Germany (KW.TW Machinery GmbH). The company has established international sales networks and operates in both domestic Chinese markets and overseas markets, with significant export business primarily settled in US dollars.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the industrial automation equipment supply chain. It manufactures finished automatic weighing and detection equipment for end-users in food, pharmaceutical, and other industries. The company sources raw materials (steel, electrical components, electronic materials) from suppliers and sells finished products directly to customers or through distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is to become a large-scale, highly competitive automatic weighing equipment supplier with internationally advanced production technology. Key R&D directions include: (1) developing high-end intelligent weighing equipment; (2) creating differentiated customized models; (3) expanding into new application fields; (4) developing smart water meters and IoT-enabled products; (5) enhancing product speed, precision, and stability; (6) expanding research teams and introducing high-end talent. The company invested 17.41 million yuan in R&D in 2024, representing 7.37% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automatic weighing and detection equipment to customers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, which occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales, or upon shipment and customs clearance for export sales. The company also generates revenue from equipment rental (6.23 million yuan in 2024) and provides technical services including installation, debugging, and training. The company operates both direct sales (87.54% of revenue) and distributor sales (12.46% of revenue) channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of automatic weighing equipment. According to China Metrology Association statistics, the company's microcomputer combination scale products rank among the top in domestic market share. The company competes with both domestic and international competitors. Compared to foreign competitors, the company has cost advantages due to lower labor and material costs in China, and offers superior price-to-performance ratios. The company's products can substitute for imported equipment. The company holds two brands: Highdream (海川智能) and Guangdong Anben (广东安本), with the English trademark 'HDM' being highly recognized by domestic and international customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 236.43 million yuan (up 4.85% from 225.50 million yuan in 2023) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 47.83 million yuan (up 32.18% from 36.19 million yuan in 2023). The company's total assets were 647.26 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has demonstrated consistent profitability with net profit margins of approximately 20%. Operating cash flow improved significantly to 45.83 million yuan in 2024 from 26.91 million yuan in 2023, representing a 70.29% increase. The company is in a growth phase with expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) High-performance customized solutions - the company provides personalized product design, manufacturing, installation, debugging, and technical training tailored to specific customer needs; (2) Superior cost-performance ratio - compared to foreign competitors, the company offers significantly lower prices while maintaining comparable quality and performance; (3) Advanced technology - the company's products in speed, precision, and stability approach international advanced levels; (4) Comprehensive service - the company provides complete solutions from equipment design through after-sales support; (5) Brand recognition - the company's HDM trademark is highly recognized in both domestic and international markets; (6) Proven track record - the company is among the earliest domestic manufacturers of automatic weighing equipment with extensive industry experience and customer relationships.
